title: Ancestor Metric2 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ancestor:metric2
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often ancestor metric2 (2) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on ancestor metric2 (2) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It rates how often your ancestor metric2 (2) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
